name: New Universal Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: New Universal Science and Technology Co., Ltd., a Beijing-headquartered firm founded in 2003, is a comprehensive Chinese enterprise. It specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, system integration, and ongoing operation and maintenance of various industrial equipment. Its robust environmental technology division provides solutions for managing both air and water quality. This includes advanced systems for waste gas treatment, such as dust collectors, VOCS removal units, and desulfurization and denitrification products, as well as comprehensive solutions for municipal sewage and industrial wastewater treatment. Additionally, the company develops and supplies intelligent equipment tailored for industrial automation. This portfolio encompasses sophisticated systems like smart and environmentally conscious mixer feeding units, micro-computer control systems, pneumatic conveyors, automated powder additive dosing, and integrated solutions for rubber processing, spanning mixing, preparation, and specialized transportation and inspection lines for finished tires, including natural rubber/white carbon black wet mixing systems. Beyond hardware and environmental systems, New Universal offers a suite of information technology solutions designed to optimize manufacturing and logistics. These include Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), barcode-based error-proofing and tracking (poka-yoke), workshop group control, Kanban management, and integrated logistics transportation and warehousing systems. The company formally rebranded to New Universal Science and Technology Co., Ltd. in February 2020, having previously operated as Beijing New Universal Science and Technology Co., Ltd.
